```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
data <- read_excel("Data.xlsx")
speciescount <- read_excel("species_inventory.xlsx")
#对接物种中文英文名
data <- merge(data,speciescount,by.x="Species",by.y = "Chinese_Name",all.x = TRUE)
data <- data %>% filter(Taxonomy %in% c("Bird","Mammal"))
dataF <- subset(data, Camera %in% c("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5","F6","F8","F9","FT10","FT11","FT12","FT13","FT14"))
dataQ <- subset(data, Camera %in% c("Q1","Q2","Q3","Q4","Q5","Q6","Q7","QT7","Q8","Q10","QT10"))

data_clean <- data %>% dplyr::select(Location, Camera, Common_Name, Taxonomy, Date, Number)

data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  # 1. Remove rows where Common_Name is feral dog or feral cat
  filter(!Common_Name %in% c("rat","shrew","bat","leaf warbler")) %>%
  
  # 2. Remove rows where Camera is one of the FT series listed
  filter(!Camera %in% c("FT10", "FT11", "FT12", "FT13", "FT14")) %>%
  
  # 3. Rename QT7 to Q7 and QT10 to Q10
  mutate(Camera = case_when(
    Camera == "QT7" ~ "Q7",
    Camera == "QT10" ~ "Q10",
    TRUE ~ Camera # Keep all other camera names the same
  )) %>%
  
  # 4. Rerank (sort) the dataframe by Camera
  arrange(Camera)

data_time_controlled <- data_clean %>%
  # 1. Ensure the Date column is properly formatted as a Date object
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% 
  # 2. Filter for the date range (inclusive)
  filter(Date >= as.Date("2024-07-05") & Date <= as.Date("2025-02-10"))

Nsp_time_controlled <- data_time_controlled %>% group_by(Location, Taxonomy) %>%
  summarise(N_Species = n_distinct(Common_Name), .groups = "drop")

#install.packages("iNEXT")
library(iNEXT)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
data_mammal <- data %>% filter(Taxonomy == "Mammal")
data_mammal <- subset(data_mammal, !(Common_Name%in% c("rat","shrew","bat")))

data_extrapo_mammal <- data_mammal %>%
  # 确保日期格式正确
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>%
  # 按物种和样地分组，计算每个物种在每个样地的唯一记录天数
  group_by(Common_Name, Location) %>%
  summarise(Days_Recorded = n_distinct(Date), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  # 转换数据格式：物种为行，样地为列
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Location,
    values_from = Days_Recorded,
    values_fill = 0  # 将缺失值填充为0
  ) %>%
  # 重命名第一列为"Species"
  rename(Species = `Common_Name`)

first_row_values <- c(2673,1839)
# 获取样地列名（排除Species列）
location_columns <- colnames(data_extrapo_mammal)[-1]

# 创建第一行数据
first_row <- data.frame(
  Species = "Sample_Size",  # 第一行的标识
  matrix(first_row_values, nrow = 1, 
         dimnames = list(NULL, location_columns))
)

# 将第一行添加到数据框
data_extrapo_mammal <- bind_rows(first_row, data_extrapo_mammal)
data_extrapo_mammal <- data_extrapo_mammal %>% select(Fushan, Qishan)

inext_result_mammal = iNEXT(data_extrapo_mammal, 
  q = 0,                   
  datatype = 'incidence_freq',
  endpoint = 5000,           # 外推终点
  nboot = 1000,
  knots = 40)

ggiNEXT(inext_result_mammal, type = 1) + 
  labs(x = 'Monitoring Days', y = 'Number of Detected Mammal Species') + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.line = element_line(color = 'black', size = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 15)),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size = 12, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = 'bottom'
  )+
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,15, by = 2))

```

data_bird <- data %>% filter(Taxonomy == "Bird")

  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>%

  group_by(Common_Name, Location) %>%
  summarise(Days_Recorded = n_distinct(Date), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  # 转换数据格式：物种为行，样地为列
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Location,
    values_from = Days_Recorded,
    values_fill = 0  # 将缺失值填充为0
  ) %>%
  # 重命名第一列为"Species"
  rename(Species = `Common_Name`)

# 获取样地列名（排除Species列）
location_columns <- colnames(data_extrapo_bird)[-1]

# 创建第一行数据
first_row <- data.frame(
  Species = "Sample_Size",  # 第一行的标识
  matrix(first_row_values, nrow = 1, 
         dimnames = list(NULL, location_columns))
)

# 将第一行添加到数据框

ggiNEXT(inext_result_bird, type = 1) +

  )+
